name: PlenOctree Conversion
definition: A pipeline to convert a trained NeRF-SH model into a sparse octree representation (PlenOctree) for real-time rendering. The octree stores density and SH coefficients at leaves.
summary: PlenOctree Conversion transforms a trained NeRF-SH model into a sparse octree to enable real-time volume rendering by pre-tabulating view-dependent radiance, avoiding the performance bottleneck of dense neural network inference.
